raw_segments.text: It must always be remembered, however, that it is the luxuries and not the necessary expense
of the inferior ranks of people that ought ever to be taxed.
The final payment of any tax upon their necessary expense would fall altogether upon the superior
ranks of people, upon the smaller portion of the annual produce, and not upon the greater.
